label: Joint-prefix contracted cyclic path matrix density - proper joint NLL over 15 active 1s returns - controlled larger-input successor using preceding 1s 530-channel union reconstructed differentiably from primitive histories - one recurrent block shared across all steps - W256 - Q16 - D64 - O32 - DQ128 DO256 embedding compression - 256k clean - batch 10240 train and evaluation - shared-step compilation without CUDA Graphs - no dropout - no adversarial inputs or outputs - no auxiliary expectation loss - no SAM - weight EMA 4 epochs - online affine 64k validation

architecture.marketState: m0=GNGLU(normalize(feature_graph(primitive_history[t])),W); one dense recurrent block and an absolute-step embedding are shared across all 15 horizons
architecture.pathWeights: at every step the market state emits QD_s and decodes q_s=P(rho_s)=softmax(row-dot(P_s,QD_s)/sqrt(Q)) from the current embedded paths
architecture.conditionalReturns: T_s=row-softmax(P_s R_s/sqrt(Q)); J_s=q_s[:,None] times T_s; p_s=sum_D(J_s)
architecture.embeddingCompression: the complete P_s and J_s matrices are independently compressed by dense uncapped GNGLUs to 128 and 256 values; P_s+1=shared-dense-GNGLU(concat(compress(P_s),m_s,compress(J_s),point-state_s))
architecture.jointPathContraction: the forecast stream always compresses the complete J_s; a parallel realized-prefix stream contracts J_s with the observed triangular-component densities, normalizes the posterior path matrix, passes it through the same embedding transition, and lets the same next market query decode q_s+1; the 15 conditional log densities sum to log p(r_1:15|x) without sampled rollout
architecture.gradientMemory: exact recurrent-step activation recomputation retains only step-boundary states, recomputes each shared block during reverse traversal, and accumulates all 15 exact unrolled-gradient contributions into the shared parameters
architecture.matrixApproximation: none; every GNGLU uses dense matrices at expected hidden width floor((input+output)/2)
architecture.outputPoints: ordered market-conditioned unit-interval knots initialized from the fixed global 32-knot grid

density.targetFilter: each start and all 15 following targets are chronological exact-nonzero active 1s returns
density.trainingLoss: proper joint path NLL: mean of the 15 forward-contracted conditional log-density terms whose sum is log p(r_1:15|x); emitted marginals are not multiplied as independent returns
